jobPostingInfo.title: Financial Analyst - Financial Strategy
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed.  We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

Job Description

U.S. Bank Finance is seeking a Financial Analyst to support financial strategy, disciplined decision-making, and execution across a business focused on helping communities grow and succeed. This role will organize the cadence of strategic conversations, develop clear and decision-ready materials, and build repeatable analytical tools that connect business initiatives to short- and long-term financial outcomes.

The successful candidate will combine financial analysis, business acumen, organization, and concise communication to help leaders evaluate opportunities, understand performance drivers, and make informed strategic choices. The analyst will collaborate with Finance, Impact Finance business leaders, and other partners to improve the consistency, transparency, and quality of strategic planning.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain a strategic conversation calendar that establishes a consistent cadence for leadership discussions, initiative reviews, decision points, and follow-up actions.

  • Coordinate inputs, timelines, and stakeholders so strategic topics are addressed at the appropriate time and supported by complete, accurate information.

  • Prepare discussion materials, executive summaries, presentations, briefing notes, and data-driven narratives that clearly connect financial results and operational facts to business implications.

  • Build and maintain a standardized business case template and supporting process for evaluating strategic initiatives.

  • Track approved business cases against actual results, forecasts, milestones, and original assumptions; identify variances, risks, opportunities, and required actions.

  • Maintain process documentation, model governance, version control, and quality checks to support transparency and repeatability.

  • Identify opportunities to streamline reporting, planning, and analytical processes through Excel, visualization tools, automation, and responsible use of AI.

  • Perform ad hoc financial analysis and support special projects as business priorities evolve.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

  • Typically three or more years of related experience in financial analysis, planning, accounting, business analytics, or a comparable analytical role.

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Working knowledge of financial analysis, forecasting, planning, profitability analysis, and general accounting principles.

  • Ability to build and maintain financial models that incorporate revenue, expense, timing, investment, and profitability assumptions.

  • Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills; experience with Power BI or other data visualization tools is beneficial.

  • Well-developed analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify trends, investigate variances, and resolve data exceptions.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to simplify complex information and create clear, concise materials for leadership.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage recurring deliverables, multiple stakeholders, and changing priorities.

  • Curiosity, initiative, sound judgment, and a collaborative approach to working across teams.

What Success Looks Like

  • Leadership has a reliable calendar and well-prepared materials for strategic conversations and decisions.

  • Business cases are evaluated consistently using transparent assumptions and comparable financial measures.

  • Short- and long-term revenue, expense, and profitability expectations are visible, monitored, and updated as facts change.

  • Actual performance and initiative progress are clearly connected to original business case commitments.

  • Financial analysis is accurate, timely, practical, and translated into actionable insights.

*This role requires working from a U.S. Bank location three (3) or more days per week.

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate a disability during any portion of the application or hiring process, please refer to our disability accommodations for applicants.

Benefits: 

Our approach to benefits and total rewards considers our team members’ whole selves and what may be needed to thrive in and outside work. That's why our benefits are designed to help you and your family boost your health, protect your financial security and give you peace of mind. Our benefits include the following:

  • Healthcare (medical, dental, vision)

  • Basic term and optional term life insurance

  • Short-term and long-term disability

  • Pregnancy disability and parental leave

  • 401(k) and employer-funded retirement plan

  • Paid vacation (from two to five weeks depending on salary grade and tenure)

  • Up to 11 paid holiday opportunities

  • Adoption assistance

  • Sick and Safe Leave accruals of one hour for every 30 worked, up to 80 hours per calendar year unless otherwise provided by law

Review our full benefits available by employment status here.

U.S. Bank is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, religion, color, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or veteran status, and other factors protected under applicable law.

E-Verify

U.S. Bank participates in the U.S. Department of Homeland Security E-Verify program in all facilities located in the United States and certain U.S. territories. The E-Verify program is an Internet-based employment eligibility verification system operated by the U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services. Learn more about the E-Verify program.

The salary range reflects figures based on the primary location, which is listed first. The actual range for the role may differ based on the location of the role. In addition to salary, U.S. Bank offers a comprehensive benefits package, including incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase 401(k) contribution and pension (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). Pay Range: $86,360.00 - $101,600.00

U.S. Bank will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records for employment. U.S. Bank conducts background checks consistent with applicable local laws, including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act as well as the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. U.S. Bank is subject to, and conducts background checks consistent with the requirements of Section 19 of the Federal Deposit Insurance Act (FDIA). In addition, certain positions may also be subject to the requirements of FINRA, NMLS registration, Reg Z, Reg G, OFAC, the NFA, the FCPA, the Bank Secrecy Act, the SAFE Act, and/or federal guidelines applicable to an agreement, such as those related to ethics, safety, or operational procedures.

Applicants must be able to comply with U.S. Bank policies and procedures including the Code of Ethics and Business Conduct and related workplace conduct and safety policies.

Posting may be closed earlier due to high volume of applicants.

jobPostingInfo.title: Sr. Director  - Product Strategy
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Product

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience:
 

Salesforce is seeking a visionary Senior Director of Technical Product Strategy to join our Product Strategy & Innovation team. This is a rare opportunity to operate at the intersection of long-range market dynamics, multi-year product positioning, and complex technical architecture—defining not just what Salesforce builds next, but why, where to invest, and how to scale the platform footprint.

Reporting directly to the SVP of Product Strategy, you will serve as a key architect of our forward-looking technology thesis. Rather than managing sprint backlogs, feature prioritization, or short-term execution roadmaps, you will lead and grow a team of technical product strategists charged with identifying emerging white spaces, evaluating build-buy-partner choices, and translating macro market shifts into durable enterprise platform strategies.
 

This role sits far above tactical feature delivery. We are looking for a strategy leader who moves ahead of trends—someone who proactively surfaces structural portfolio gaps, stress-tests multi-year technical investments, and establishes the strategic frameworks that will define our enterprise platform for the next decade.
 

From shaping the long-term productization pathways for core capabilities—spanning trust infrastructure, workflow automation, and agentic AI architectures—to framing investment theses around high-growth sectors like supply chain agentification, developer tooling, and AI-native systems of record, you will ensure Salesforce invests in the right bets, at the right time, with the right commercial and technical models.
 

What You'll Actually Be Doing:

  • Define Long-Range Product Strategy: Lead macro product strategy, whitespace identification, and multi-year positioning frameworks across Salesforce's enterprise AI and platform portfolio.

  • Architect Productization Pathways: Shape the strategic transition of internal technical capabilities—trust infrastructure, workflow automation, agentic AI, and data platforms—into standalone product lines or platform-integrated offerings.

  • Drive Build-Buy-Partner Frameworks: Own and evolve structural decision frameworks for build vs. buy vs. partner evaluations, defining optimal platform integration timelines versus independent go-to-market strategies.

  • Translate Market & Tech Paradigms: Assess foundational shifts—including agentic coding, AI-native application architectures, supply chain automation, and open-source ecosystems—and translate them into executive-level investment theses.

  • Identify Portfolio Gaps: Partner with the SVP to proactively map portfolio vulnerabilities and market opportunities, establishing strategic coverage well beyond reactive competitive analysis.

  • Synthesize Cross-Functional Signals: Integrate technical research, engineering capabilities, market intelligence, and M&A trends to build defensible points of view on long-term bets.

  • Assess Market Viability: Conduct rigorous market sizing, economic modelling, and structural competitive analysis to justify capital allocation and strategic pivots.

  • Guide Global Strategy Expansion: Partner with regional leadership to adapt Salesforce's platform strategy for European markets, accounting for local regulatory frameworks, competitive moats, and entry strategies.

  • Evaluate Go-to-Market Models: Establish framework models—open source, platform-bundled, standalone SaaS, API-first—balancing long-term monetization, developer adoption, and defensibility.

  • Monitor Horizon Signals: Track venture capital inflows, developer ecosystem shifts, and emerging research to capitalize on tech paradigms before they become industry consensus.

  • Advise Executive Leadership: Present structured, data-driven strategic choices and investment options directly to the SVP and executive leadership.

  • Scale the Strategy Organization: Recruit, mentor, and lead a high-performing technical strategy team, establishing scalable practices for horizon scanning and opportunity evaluation.
     

You're Our Person If You Have:

  • 12+ years of experience spanning product strategy, technology strategy, corporate strategy, or strategic product management at a leading cloud platform or enterprise software company.

  • Demonstrated leadership experience building and directing teams of 3+ strategists, technical market analysts, or senior product leaders in ambiguous environments.

  • Deep structural understanding of enterprise AI/ML architectures, agentic systems, and platform integration patterns, with a focus on strategic differentiation rather than daily execution.

  • Strong architectural fluency in enterprise systems of record, data platforms, and SaaS infrastructure, including how AI layers alter long-term software economics.

  • Expertise in business model design, including the trade-offs across open-source, proprietary, platform-native, and standalone API commercialization models.

  • Direct experience framing M&A strategy, including thesis development, market entry strategy, or build-buy-partner evaluations.

  • Exemplary executive communication skills, with a track record of framing complex, multi-variable strategic analyses for executive teams and boards.

  • High comfort with ambiguity, possessing the intellectual rigor to define unconstrained problem spaces and frame actionable hypotheses.
     

Even Better If You Have:

  • Experience leading technical strategy or corporate innovation at an AI-first company, platform vendor, or top-tier technology strategy consultancy.

  • Deep familiarization with developer platform ecosystems, AI-assisted software development, and modern developer tooling moats.

  • Strategic domain knowledge in enterprise supply chain automation, process agentification, or vertical AI applications.

  • A proven track record of originating novel investment theses and productization strategies from first principles.

  • Background in venture capital, corporate development, or tech investment, with an ability to map funding signals to enterprise platform opportunities.

  • A builder's mindset focused on framing new markets, business models, and organizational strategies rather than optimizing existing product backlogs.

  • Experience crafting both offensive GTM strategies and defensive portfolio positioning.

  • Advanced degree (MBA, MS, or equivalent) in a business or technical field, though demonstrated strategic outcomes remain paramount.

LI-Y*

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. Salesforce offers a variety of benefits to help you live well including: time off programs, medical, dental, vision, mental health support, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, 401(k), and an employee stock purchasing program. More details about company benefits can be found at the following link: https://www.salesforcebenefits.com.Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

You'll operate across both owned hotspot programs and influenced work with Cloud Field Marketing and OU Marketing, with equal weight given to direct execution and strategic influence. This is a hybrid role with three days in office each week.

  • You are the team's lead funnel expert. You understand where leads stall by OU and segment, you know the scoring and routing logic, and you use that intelligence to design always on programs.

  • Launch on time, optimize mid-flight based on engagement and conversion signals, and build repeatable playbooks that scale across OUs and future quarters

  • Use funnel performance data to inform program design, ensuring execution targets the right accounts at the right stage

  • Partner with Marketing Ops and BDR leadership on scoring, routing, and lead quality improvements

  • Own the marketing-to-sales handoff for every program: build target account lists, develop ProspectingIQ guides, and deliver contact intelligence that gives BDRs and AEs a clear starting point

  • Understand the event lead scoring model to ensure leads captured at events are scored, routed, and handed off with the context sellers need to follow through

  • Partner with BDR Dev Ops to align program outputs to their existing tooling and infrastructure

  • Measure handoff effectiveness through response rate, time-to-contact, and lead-to-opportunity conversion, and close the loop with Sales Development and Field Sales on what's working

  • You can take a brief from strategy to launch across multiple channels and stakeholders

  • You're comfortable working in lead funnel data and can read a conversion report to make decisions, not just report on outcomes

  • You've worked closely with Sales Development or BDR teams and understand how sellers think and what makes a handoff useful

  • You're a strong cross-functional collaborator who can manage competing priorities and keep multiple workstreams moving

  • You're a clear communicator who can translate campaign logic into simple, seller-ready messaging

jobPostingInfo.title: Analyst, Actuarial
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Position Summary

We are seeking an Analyst to join the NA/PEX (National Accounts and Private Exchanges) Actuarial team to support the pricing, forecasting, and financial management of our fully insured business. This position provides a unique opportunity to build actuarial expertise through hands-on experience with pricing models, large-scale data analysis, and strategic business decision-making. The Analyst will collaborate with actuarial, underwriting, finance, and other business partners to evaluate emerging trends, develop pricing assumptions, enhance analytical tools, and support both new and renewal business opportunities. Through exposure to a broad range of actuarial functions, this role offers a strong foundation for professional development and actuarial exam progression while contributing directly to business performance and growth.

More specifically, this role will be responsible for the following:

  • Developing the underlying pricing factors and assumptions used in NA/PEX pricing
  • Maintaining pricing tools and assisting with enhancements
  • Conducting ad hoc pricing studies and requests from businesses partners
  • Monitoring of emerging results
  • Collaborating with Underwriting on plan sponsor pricing opportunities for both new business and renewal business. 
  • Collaborating with other departments to assist with pricing assumptions

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Actuarial Science strongly preferred. Candidates with degrees in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Chemistry, or a closely related quantitative field will also be considered.
  • 0-1 years of related experience required.
  • Pursuing ASA with 1-2 exams passed
  • Experience working with large and detailed data sets


Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Solid technical, analytical, and creative problem-solving skills
  • Be organized, data driven, statistically minded and demonstrate attention to detail
  • Be self-motivated, intellectually curious with a desire to continuously improve processes
  • Be adaptable as business needs and priorities evolve


Education

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in actuarial science or related field
  • 1-2 Actuarial exams

Anticipated Weekly Hours

40

Time Type

Full time

Pay Range
